The '''Long-Range Sensor Field''' was a field located in the [[Whiterock Wastes]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Long-Range Sensor Field appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
